About.title: About Our Store
About.subtitle: We are committed to bringing you quality fashion that fits your lifestyle.
About.metaDescription: Learn more about Fashion Store and what we stand for.
About.paragraph1: Fashion Store is a Bangladeshi e-commerce platform dedicated to curating stylish, high-quality apparel for every occasion. Our mission is to make fashion accessible, sustainable, and effortless for everyone in Bangladesh.
About.paragraph2: From timeless essentials to trend-forward statement pieces, we source premium materials and work with trusted partners to deliver products across the country you will love.
About.heroSubtitle: Since our founding, we've been on a mission to bring premium Bangladeshi fashion to every doorstep. Quality, authenticity, and customer delight drive everything we do.

banner.title: Premium Fashion, Delivered Across Bangladesh
banner.subtitle: Handpicked designs, festival-ready outfits and everyday essentials — all crafted with the care your style deserves.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To democratize premium fashion across Bangladesh — making designer-quality ethnic and contemporary wear accessible, affordable, and delivered to your doorstep.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To become Bangladesh's most loved fashion destination, where every customer finds their perfect style — from timeless ethnic classics to contemporary trends.

quality.title: Uncompromising Quality
quality.description: Every piece is curated from premium fabrics with meticulous attention to detail — because you deserve nothing less.

authenticity.title: Authenticity First
authenticity.description: We celebrate Bangladeshi craftsmanship, working with local artisans and designers to bring authentic heritage to modern wardrobes.

customer.title: Customer Delight
customer.description: From seamless shopping to hassle-free returns, your experience is our top priority. We're here for you at every step.

sustainability.title: Sustainable Practices
sustainability.description: We partner with responsible suppliers and minimize waste — because fashion shouldn't come at the cost of our planet.

story.title: Our Journey
story.subtitle: From a small vision to thousands of happy customers — here's how we grew.

2022.title: The Beginning
2022.description: Founded with a simple goal: bring authentic Bangladeshi fashion online with uncompromising quality.

2023.title: Expansion
2023.description: Launched nationwide delivery, expanded to 500+ curated products, and served 10,000+ customers.

2024.title: Milestones
2024.description: Reached 50,000+ happy customers, introduced COD & bKash, and launched our mobile app.

2025.title: The Future
2025.description: Scaling sustainable practices, opening experience centers, and bringing Bangladeshi fashion globally.

Terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions governing the use of Fashion Store.
Terms.heroSubtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using Fashion Store. By shopping with us you agree to the following.

sections.title: 1. Agreement to Terms
sections.body: By accessing and using the Fashion Store website, you accept these Terms & Conditions in full. If you disagree with any part of these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.title: 2. Products & Pricing
sections.body: We display products with the best possible accuracy. Prices are quoted in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT) and are subject to change without notice. Sale prices apply only for the stated period.

sections.title: 3. Orders & Acceptance
sections.body: All orders are subject to acceptance and availability. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel an order in cases of suspected fraud or pricing errors. A confirmation email marks acceptance.

sections.title: 4. Payment
sections.body: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), bKash, Nagad, Rocket and major credit/debit cards. For COD, please keep the exact amount ready or use our digital payment links.

sections.title: 5. Delivery & Shipping
sections.body: Standard delivery takes 2-4 business days nationwide. Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to weather or logistics. Risk passes to the buyer upon delivery.

sections.title: 6. Returns & Refunds
sections.body: Unused items with tags can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after inspection to the original payment method.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content, images, logos and trade names on this site belong to Fashion Store and may not be used without our written permission.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Fashion Store is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from the use of our site or products, to the maximum extent permitted by law.

sections.title: 9. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.title: 10. Contact Information
sections.body: Questions about these Terms may be sent to support@fashionstore.com.bd or through our contact page.

Privacy.metaDescription: How Fashion Store collects, uses and protects your personal information.
Privacy.heroSubtitle: Your trust matters to us. This policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and how we keep it safe.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, email, phone number, shipping address and payment method when you place an order or create an account. We also collect limited technical data like device type and pages visited to improve your experience.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: Your information is used to process orders, deliver products, provide customer support, send order updates and, with your consent, share promotional offers. We never sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Payment Security
sections.body: All payments are processed through secure, PCI-DSS compliant gateways (bKash, Nagad, Rocket and card networks). We do not store your full card number or payment credentials on our servers.

sections.title: 4. Cookies & Tracking
sections.body: We use cookies to keep your cart items, remember preferences and understand how visitors browse our site. You can control or disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.

sections.title: 5. Data Sharing
sections.body: We share information only with trusted partners who help us deliver — such as courier services and payment processors — and only to the extent needed to fulfill your order.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.body: Order records are kept for warranty and accounting purposes as required by law. You may request deletion of your account and personal data at any time by contacting our support team.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information, and to opt out of marketing communications at any time through your account or by contacting us.

sections.title: 8. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our services are not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided data, please contact us immediately.

sections.title: 9. Policy Updates
sections.body: We may update this policy periodically to reflect legal or operational changes. Material changes will be announced on this page with an updated effective date.

sections.title: 10. Contact Us
sections.body: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at privacy@fashionstore.com.bd. We aim to respond to all privacy inquiries within 48 hours.
